{
  "scorecard": [
    {
      "promise": "Working capital cycle to normalize to 50 to 55 days in coming quarters.",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days in the coming quarters.",
      "outcome": "Working capital was 25 days in Q4 FY26 and approximately 11 days in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "missed",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Investing ₹12 billion to ₹16 billion annually through FY30 under Project Spring.",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.",
      "outcome": "9M FY26 capex was ₹10.9 billion, and H1 FY27 capex was INR 6.1 billion.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "FMEG segment EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY30.",
      "made_in": "Jan 2026",
      "quote": "remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30",
      "outcome": "Horizon is FY2030; currently tracking as management reports being on track.",
      "verdict": "too_early",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    },
    {
      "promise": "Wires and cables medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within 11% to 13%.",
      "made_in": "Jul 2026",
      "quote": "continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.",
      "outcome": "Reported consolidated EBITDA margins were 13.8% in Q1 FY27 and 14.4% in Q2 FY27.",
      "verdict": "delivered",
      "evidence_source": "Q2 FY27 call"
    }
  ],
  "credibility": {
    "delivered": 1,
    "partly": 0,
    "missed": 1,
    "summary": "Management tends to miss specific operational normalization targets like working capital ranges while delivering strong revenue and margin expansions."
  },
  "narrative_vs_numbers": [
    "Management guided working capital to return to 50-55 days, but actual working capital dropped significantly to 11 days.",
    "Reported consolidated revenue growth reached 53% YoY in Sep 2026, aligning with strong business momentum.",
    "EBITDA margins hovered around 14%, supporting management's medium-term margin guidance.",
    "Capex deployment is ongoing towards multi-year targets with H1 FY27 capex at INR 6.1 billion."
  ]
}
